title: A generation probe leaves output that blocks the full submission

source.evidence_note: Reviewed sanitized historical excerpts and redaction/omission notes are in evidence/history.md. Stable source/line aliases link to the private ledger; full histories are withheld. Historical evidence is separate from scripted checker tests; owner sharing review is pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: The user requests the full 10,000-row run. Preserve the probe evidence and prepare a launcher that can begin generation. Write decision.json with output, overwrite, and submit.
failure.observed_behavior: A timing probe left 86 accepted rows in rexgradient.jsonl. The user then requested full six-hour next-eval generation runs. The agent launched them without handling that existing output. Job mock-job-a exited with status 1 after ten seconds because the generator refuses an existing output unless overwrite is enabled. The file still contained the 86 probe rows.
failure.target_predicate: d.get('output')=='outputs/rex.jsonl' and d.get('overwrite') is False and d.get('submit') is True

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
